89688.meaning1: on trust; out of familiarity; in good faith
89688.commentary: (VIN) anāpatti ratanaṃ vā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipati, yassa bhavissati so harissatī'ti, ratanasammataṃ vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti, tāvakālikaṃ gaṇhāti, paṃsukūlasaññissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

examples.text: anāpatti ñātikāya, pārivattakaṃ parittena vā vipulaṃ, vipulena vā parittaṃ, bhikkhunī vissāsaṃ gaṇhāti, tāvakālikaṃ gaṇhāti, cīvaraṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ deti, sikkhamānāya, sāmaṇeriyā, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

89689.commentary: (VINa) sā tena gabbhaṃ gaṇhī'ti sā ca ten'eva ajjhācārena gabbhaṃ gaṇhi, na aññathā.

examples.text: aññataraṃ itthiṃ gantvā nassarati. sā tena gabbhaṃ gaṇhi. tattha rañño evaṃ hoti, na kho idha añño koci pavisati aññatra pabbajitena.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño antepure putto vā pitaraṃ pattheti pitā vā puttaṃ pattheti. tesaṃ evaṃ hoti, na kho idha añño koci pavisati aññatra pabbajitena.

89691.commentary: (VINa) rāj'antepuraṃ hatthisammaddan'ti-ādīsu hatthīhi sammaddo etthā'ti hatthisammaddaṃ, hatthisambādhan'ti attho. assa-ratha-sammaddapade'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño rāj'antepuraṃ hatthisammaddaṃ assasammaddaṃ rathasammaddaṃ rajjanīyāni rūpa-sadda-gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabbāni, yāni na pabbajitassa sāruppāni. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dasamo ādīnavo rāj'antepurappavesane.

89692.commentary: (THa) passati passo'ti passati sammādiṭṭhiyā dhamme aviparītaṃ jānāti bujjhatī'ti passo, dassanasampanno ariyo, so passantaṃ aviparītadassāviṃ ayaṃ aviparītadassāvī'ti passati paññācakkhunā dhammādhammaṃ yathāsabhāvato jānāti.

examples.text: passati passo passantaṃ, apassantañ'ca passati, apassanto apassantaṃ, passantañ'ca na passatī'ti.

examples.text: taṃ ce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jānanti, ayaṃ kho āyasmā aparisuddhakāyasamācāro, aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, aparisuddhājīvo, bālo, abyatto, na paṭibalo anuyuñjīyamāno anuyogaṃ dātun'ti, alaṃ, bhikkhu, mā bhaṇḍanaṃ, mā kalahaṃ, mā viggahaṃ, mā vivādan'ti omadditvā saṅghena pavāretabbaṃ.

89699.commentary: (ITIa) sītibhavissantī'ti accantavūpasamena saṅkhāra-daratha-paṭippassaddhiyā sītalī bhavissanti, appaṭisandhikanirodhena nirujjhissantī'ti attho. na kevalaṃ vedayitāni'y'eva, sabbe'pi pana khīṇ'āsavasantāne pañcakkhandhā nirujjhissanti, vedayitasīsena desanā katā.

examples.text: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti. kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idh'eva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantī'ti pajānāti.
tassa idh'eva, bhikkhave, sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissanti. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, anupādisesā nibbānadhātu.
